sinusitis.whenSeeDocBody: If you've had sinus symptoms for more than 12 weeks, or if symptoms keep coming back after you treat them, it's time to talk to a doctor.

about.title: Built to get patients out from under sinus pain.
about.subtitle: Most patients with chronic sinus problems spend years in primary care before getting a real answer. ExcelENT exists to shorten that path.
about.mission1: Sinus problems are one of the most undertreated conditions in primary care. Patients often spend years on rotating antibiotic courses and decongestants before they get to the right care.
about.mission2: ExcelENT was founded to close that gap — connecting patients directly to the doctors who treat sinus problems every day, with the latest minimally invasive techniques and a clear path to relief.
about.mission3: Our focus is patient outcomes: see them quickly, treat them well, get them breathing again.
about.beliefsSubtitle: Four principles that shape how we work — every patient, every visit.
about.belief1Title: Treat the cause, not the symptom
about.belief1Body: Sinus issues need root-cause analysis, not another rotation of antibiotics. We invest in figuring out what's actually wrong before reaching for a prescription pad.
about.belief2Body: Most patients see a doctor within five days of scheduling. The best plan in the world doesn't help if you can't get an appointment.
about.belief3Body: Straight talk on what's happening in your sinuses, what your treatment options actually involve, and what it'll cost. No fine print.
about.belief4Body: Most sinus procedures today are 20-minute, in-office treatments. We treat surgery as a last resort and meet most patients with options that don't disrupt their lives.
about.teamBody: The operators and clinical leaders behind ExcelENT.

team.kashifBio: Dr. Mazhar is a practicing otolaryngologist in Raleigh, NC, and the founder of ExcelENT. He started ExcelENT after years of meeting patients in his clinic who had been told their sinus pain wasn't serious — patients who'd cycled through antibiotics and decongestants for years before anyone took a closer look. ExcelENT exists to shorten that path.
team.kevinBio: Kevin leads ExcelENT's patient growth, focused on getting more people connected with the right care faster. He brings 30+ years working in healthcare operations and patient access.
team.joshBio: Josh leads ExcelENT's clinical operations — the workflows that take a patient from first inquiry through their appointment and follow-up. 13 years in the field with a focus on the patient experience.
team.ericBio: Eric leads patient awareness and engagement at ExcelENT — the marketing and education that helps people find us before their symptoms become chronic. 15 years on the East Coast healthcare corridor.
